hero.subtitle: CAPTURING LOVE
philosophy: We don't photograph weddings. We immortalize the way they look at each other when they think no one is watching.
Every frame is an emotional decision. We seek truth in the fleeting, beauty in the invisible.
We craft visual narratives that feel like your own memories — intimate, eternal, unrepeatable.

interludes.1_quote: Every love story deserves to be told with the delicacy of a whisper and the strength of eternity.
interludes.2_quote: We don't capture moments. We create fragments of eternity that will breathe forever.
interludes.3_quote: Your story deserves more than a photograph. It deserves a visual poem that transcends time.

about.label: ABOUT ONIRIA
about.title: The way it felt.
about.intro: Wedding films shaped by emotion, light and the moments that make a story yours.
about.body: A glance across the room. A hand held a little tighter. The voices of the people you love. We are drawn to the details that bring you back to a feeling, long after the day has passed.
about.image_alt: An intimate moment from an ONIRIA wedding story

approach.title: Emotion first
approach.text: We look for the moments that feel true to you: the quiet anticipation, the unexpected laughter and everything in between.

approach.title: An editorial eye
approach.text: Light, composition and rhythm give each film its own language. Beauty lives in the smallest details as much as in the grandest moments.

approach.title: A memory to return to
approach.text: Our intention is to make films you can step back into, with the voices, gestures and atmosphere that made your wedding yours.

about.closing_text: Tell us what you are imagining. We would love to hear about your day.
